name: InternVL3-8B
notes: TWO-PART MODEL. (1) Vision: InternViT (vision_config._name_or_path InternViT-6B-448px-V1-5), 24 layers, hidden 1024, 16 heads, patch 14, image_size 448. The vision_config still carries the training-time MoE scaffolding (num_experts 8, num_routed_experts 4, num_shared_experts 4, use_moe FALSE) -- the released encoder is dense, the MoE fields are inert. (2) LLM: Qwen2-7B, 28 layers, hidden 3584, 28 heads / 4 KV, head_dim 128 (k_proj [512,3584] confirmed). ARCHITECTURE = dense (both parts dense). PROJECTOR: MLP + PIXEL-SHUFFLE. downsample_ratio 0.5 means a 2x2 spatial downsample before the MLP; ps_version 'v2'. Each 448x448 tile = (448/14)^2 = 1,024 ViT patches, and pixel-shuffle 0.5 quarters that to 256 LLM tokens per tile. This is the key efficiency move: 4x token reduction for a small projector cost, unlike InternVL2's naive per-patch MLP. DYNAMIC TILING (decides prefill cost): dynamic_image_size true, force_image_size 448, min_dynamic_patch 1, max_dynamic_patch 12, use_thumbnail true. So one image becomes between 2 and 13 ViT forward passes: up to 12 tiles of 448x448 plus a 448x448 thumbnail. VISION TOKENS: 256 per tile, so 512 tokens for a single-tile image, up to 13*256 = 3,328 tokens at the 12-tile maximum. DOMINANCE: VISION DOMINATES decisively. At the default high-res setting (12 tiles) 3,328 vision tokens swamp a ~100-token text prompt by 30:1, and the ViT runs 13 separate attention passes. Vision encoder FLOPs, not LLM prefill, are the first thing to profile on InternVL3. KV CACHE: 28 * 4 * 128 * 2 * 2 = 57,344 B/token. params_b 7.944 = HF API safetensors total (7,944,373,760).
